t: You're standing on Eaton Terrace, a street in Belgravia, central London. The name comes from Eaton Hall, the country seat of the Duke of Westminster, whose family developed this district of London. One former resident is Arnaud Bamberger, a French businessman born in 1945, who lived on this street. He is known as the former Director and Executive Chairman of Cartier, the luxury jeweller. So this is a street tied both to an aristocratic landowning family and to the world of high-end business.
